caption_review.source_Japanese: 多彩な交易品を売買してひと儲け！

observed_native_draw.text: Trade varied goods for a profit!

DK4_EXTRAS_TRADE_FORTUNE.current_card_English:
TRADE CAREERS
Trade hundreds of goods and
influence market prices.
Find rarities and open a bazaar!
DK4_EXTRAS_TRADE_FORTUNE.individual_source_finding: The card connects trade with market prices and ends with a separate invitation to open a bazaar when you find rarities.

caption_review.localization_note: The caption carries the excitement of the original sea battle alongside its image.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 洋上で繰り広げられる、熱き戦い！

DK4_EXTRAS_NAVAL_BATTLE.current_card_English:
COMBAT CAREERS
Master cannon and boarding combat
to escort merchants and explorers.
Form a pirate fleet with friends!
DK4_EXTRAS_NAVAL_BATTLE.individual_source_finding: Escort, cannon fire, boarding and forming your own pirate fleet give the combat panel its specific pitch.

caption_review.context: Online Version, First Steps, page 1 of 2.
caption_review.source_meaning: The story changes greatly with the nation you belong to.
caption_review.localization_note: The choice of nation has a major effect on the story. The active caption already expresses that relationship.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 所属国で大きく変わるストーリー！

DK4_EXTRAS_NATION_STORY.current_card_English:
Meet many characters
throughout your travels.
Your nation determines which
story will unfold!
DK4_EXTRAS_NATION_STORY.individual_source_finding: The encounters and the nation-dependent stories preserve the two parts of the source card.

caption_review.context: Online Version, First Steps, page 2 of 2.
caption_review.source_meaning: Changes bring an excitement unlike anything before.
caption_review.localization_note: The caption carries the new excitement that follows changes without adding a particular event or cause.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 変化が生み出すかつてない刺激！

DK4_EXTRAS_CHANGING_WORLD.current_card_English:
Your actions shape world affairs!
In wars for national prestige,
your vote may decide which
port becomes the next target.
DK4_EXTRAS_CHANGING_WORLD.individual_source_finding: The possible vote and the attack target remain explicit. The conditional keeps the outcome uncertain.

caption_review.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 1 of 3.
caption_review.source_meaning: Set off on an adventure with companions you have met.
caption_review.localization_note: The page describes forming a fleet with people the player meets. Companions fits that relationship without implying a political alliance.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 出会った仲間とともに冒険に出発！

DK4_EXTRAS_NEW_ALLIES.current_card_English:
Invite players you meet
to form a fleet. Combine skills
to solve mysteries and
battle pirates together!
DK4_EXTRAS_NEW_ALLIES.individual_source_finding: Forming a fleet with people you meet leads naturally into combining skills and fighting pirates.

caption_review.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 2 of 3.
caption_review.source_meaning: Race across the open sea in your own ship.
caption_review.english: Sail far in your own ship!
caption_review.localization_note: The caption preserves the emphasis on the player’s own ship and the scope of the voyage.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 自分だけの船で大海原を駆けろ！

observed_native_draw.text: Sail far in your own ship!

DK4_EXTRAS_OWN_SHIP.current_card_English:
Ships come in many sizes.
Customize their materials,
weapons, sails, and emblems!
DK4_EXTRAS_OWN_SHIP.individual_source_finding: The visible wording drops the different ship types and the ability to change the number of sails.
DK4_EXTRAS_OWN_SHIP.working_English_revision: Ships come in many types and sizes. Choose the materials, weapons, number of sails, and emblems to make one your own!

caption_review.context: Online Version, Create a Story, page 3 of 3.
caption_review.source_meaning: A grand, thrilling world of adventure.
caption_review.localization_note: The vast adventure and its enthusiasm carry the closing caption’s meaning.
caption_review.source_Japanese: 胸がおどる壮大な冒険空間！

DK4_EXTRAS_VAST_WORLD.current_card_English:
Explore 3D landmarks and cities,
from the pyramids to Pisa.
Adventure stretches endlessly
before you!
DK4_EXTRAS_VAST_WORLD.individual_source_finding: The Japanese names the Leaning Tower of Pisa. The current sentence names the city and loses the landmark.
DK4_EXTRAS_VAST_WORLD.working_English_revision: Explore 3D ruins and cities. From the pyramids to the Leaning Tower of Pisa, a whole world of adventure awaits!

DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_INTRO.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_INTRO.source_meaning: Introduces the tie-in with the PC game Uncharted Waters Online. Playing both games expands what you can do in Rota Nova.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_INTRO.english: Learn about this game's tie-in with the PC title Uncharted Waters Online. Playing both games opens new ways to enjoy this game.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_INTRO.localization_note: The introduction already identifies the other game and makes clear that the tie-in adds something to this game.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_INTRO.source_Japanese:
パソコン版ゲームソフト
『大航海時代 Online』との
タイアップについて紹介します。
『大航海時代 Online』を
あわせてプレイすることで、
本製品の楽しさが広がります。
english_lines: new ways to enjoy this game.

DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_1.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_1.source_meaning: Play the Online game and learn the village name and its password by speaking with a particular character.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_1.english: STEP 1{LB}Play Uncharted Waters Online. A certain character will tell you a village name and its Promised Words.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_1.localization_note: The paired name and password lead directly into Step 2. Use Promised Words, the name shown by the village interface.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_1.source_Japanese:
ＳＴＥＰ１
まずは『大航海時代 Online』を
プレイして、特定のキャラクター
から「村の名前」と
「約束の言葉」を聞き出します。
english_lines: you a village name and its

DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_2.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_2.source_meaning: Find that village in this game and use the password to trade with the village. Valuable trade goods become available.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_2.english: STEP 2{LB}Find that village in Rota Nova and enter its Promised Words. You can then trade for valuable new goods.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_2.localization_note: Identify Rota Nova as the game the player returns to, preserve the password term, and keep the new goods as trade goods.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_STEP_2.source_Japanese:
ＳＴＥＰ２
本製品で、その「村」を探し当て
「約束の言葉」を使うと、
「村」との交易が可能になり
高価な交易品が登場します。
english_lines: Find that village in Rota Nova

DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_VILLAGES.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_VILLAGES.source_meaning: There are 24 villages in all, and the trade goods that appear differ by village. The text invites the player to see them in person.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_VILLAGES.english: There are 24 villages, each with its own trade goods. Visit them to see what they sell.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_VILLAGES.localization_note: Keep all 24 villages and their different goods. This refers to commodities for sale and the invitation to explore.
DK4_EXTRAS_TIE_IN_VILLAGES.source_Japanese:
「村」は全部で２４カ所。
登場する交易品も「村」ごとに
異なります。
どんな交易品が登場するか、
ぜひ、あなたの目で確かめて
ください。

DK4_EXTRAS_OFFICIAL_SITE.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_OFFICIAL_SITE.source_meaning: The closing invitation directs players to the official website of Uncharted Waters Online to continue their voyages.
DK4_EXTRAS_OFFICIAL_SITE.english: Visit the official Uncharted Waters Online site and set sail again!
DK4_EXTRAS_OFFICIAL_SITE.localization_note: Restore the word official and the full game title. Treat the invitation as the original game’s copy.
DK4_EXTRAS_OFFICIAL_SITE.source_Japanese:
さあ、『大航海時代 Online』
公式サイトにアクセスして
さらなる航海の旅へ！

DK4_EXTRAS_SERVICE_NOTICE.context: About Extras leads from the PC connection through the village password instructions to the closing invitation and service notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_SERVICE_NOTICE.source_meaning: Depending on circumstances, network content services may change or end. The message asks players to keep that in mind.
DK4_EXTRAS_SERVICE_NOTICE.english: Please note that online services may change or end.
DK4_EXTRAS_SERVICE_NOTICE.localization_note: Keep the service caveat. The Japanese does not say changes will happen without notice.
DK4_EXTRAS_SERVICE_NOTICE.source_Japanese:
都合により、ネットワーク
コンテンツのサービスを変更
終了する場合があります。
ご了承ください。
